topic: Smartphone Photo Superpower: AI vs Optics
caption:
📰 Smartphone Photo Superpower: AI vs Optics

Smartphone cameras have hit a hardware ceiling. Apple, Google, and Samsung now compete on neural processing, using NPUs to fuse dozens of frames in real time. This shift makes software the primary differentiator and opens computational pipelines to developers via platform APIs.

📅 29 Oct 2026 | Source: Leading Smartphone Manufacturers (e.g., Apple, Google, Samsung) and Computational Photography Research
